name: RadiologyPlaybookRPID
title: RSNA Radiology Playbook (RPID)
description: RadLex Playbook identifiers (RPIDs) for imaging procedures, published by RSNA. MY Core binds radiology procedures to the LOINC side of the LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook and declares this code system so that systems holding RPIDs can translate them through ConceptMap/rpid-to-loinc-my-core. Content is referenced, not redistributed.
